review.imagery: Root reviewed all 41 original brochure spreads, all nineteen extracted native resources and eleven cached website candidates. Twenty-one selected renders retain villa or planned shared-community scope. Modern four/six-bedroom and Arabian five-bedroom façades retain the brochure labels. Six residential interiors retain concept scope. Shared clinic, cultural, arena, clubhouse and spine concepts do not establish completion or access entitlements. Generic lifestyle photographs, site icons and duplicate banner crops were excluded.
review.floorPlans: Root viewed all six complete original villa spreads and read every printed unit total, bedroom/guest-room list and notice. Both levels stay together. Four-bedroom A/B are 430 m², five-bedroom A/B 510 m² and six-bedroom A/B 591 m². The current webpage uses different area figures, with basis unconfirmed. Pool installation and room-dimension exclusions remain explicit. Whole original regional and master sheets retain community scope. The alternate six-page mirror was reviewed and excluded as a duplicate drawing set.
review.location: Root visually read complete original brochure regional page 7, master page 27 and the current developer SVG. The four overlapping travel estimates agree, while the brochure also gives Al Qana five minutes. No live route, journey mode, kilometre distance or exact entrance was inferred. Sales-centre coordinates remain separate from the project pin. Disneyland proposed-resort scope was corroborated with the original 7 May 2025 Disney/Miral announcement at https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/press-releases/the-walt-disney-company-and-miral-announce-plans-for-disney-theme-park-and-resort-on-yas-island-abu-dhabi/ .
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve current official HTML, website resources, original brochure/plans, alternate mirror and current SVG URLs, dates, original bytes and SHA256. Native image resources retain their original physical brochure-page attribution. Original PDFs and complete drawing notices remain intact. Existing commercial research and all protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Final contracted area basis and revision, selected-villa finishes, confirmed pool installation, resident access to every shared concept, exact surveyed villa entrance coordinates, live routing and kilometre journeys remain unverified.
